verdict.rationale: Brex supports receipt upload with automatic matching to expenses via API ("Upload receipt and match automatically", pre-signed S3 URL matching to existing expenses) and AI agents that 'fetch receipts' automatically, but there's no explicit evidence of OCR technology, photo-snap mobile capture flow, or email-forwarding-to-receipt-filing as described in the story. missing for 10: explicit OCR mention, mobile photo-capture UX details, email-forwarding ingestion mechanism, independent/hands-on confirmation of accuracy.
